ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines $AB$ and $CD$ intersect at point $O$, with $OE\perp CD$. If $\angle AOE=50^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $OE \perp CD$,\\
it follows that $\angle EOC=90^\circ$,\\
which means $\angle EOA+\angle AOC=90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle AOE=50^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC=90^\circ-50^\circ=40^\circ$,\\
Therefore, $\angle BOD=\angle AOC=\boxed{40^\circ}$.
